design_description: A modern reinterpretation of classic vertical stripes, built around a bold royal blue and white color scheme. The wide central blue stripe creates a strong focal point, while the surrounding white panels preserve a traditional football identity. Dynamic blue and gold diagonal streaks cut across the white sections, adding movement and a contemporary edge without overwhelming the design. Matching gold sleeve accents and the yellow crest tie the palette together and provide a premium finish. Overall, the kit feels energetic, balanced, and heritage-inspired — blending classic stripes with modern graphic detailing.
